name: Austin Fire Explorers Post 370
org: Austin Fire Department with Capitol Area Council, Scouting America
what_you_do: Learn how to fight fires, do rescues and give first aid, taught by Austin firefighters. You get real gear and train where they train. Teams compete in fire games each year.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 through 19. Co-ed. You do not need to be in top shape.
pay_detail: No pay or fee is stated on the page.
duration: Weekend meetings, one day each weekend for several weeks before each competition
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the interest card to get updates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online interest card to get on the email list. You can send questions by email to the fire team at firerecruiting@austintexas.gov.
notes: Teams compete in the DFW Fire Games in the spring and the San Antonio fire games in the fall. Being an Explorer does not hurt you if you apply to be a firefighter later. There are also ways to volunteer.
